name: BT Catalog
changelog: New filters: Gender/Age, Neckline, Sleeve Length, Style (pullover/quarter-zip/full-zip/snap/button), and Size — all derived at import. Filter options now carry live counts and anything with zero results is hidden entirely, so browsing crewneck sweatshirts never offers Short Sleeve and a hat shows no Neckline group at all. Fixes: sweatshirts were being returned under T-Shirts ('%tshirt%' matches 'Sweatshirts'); the featured page priced colorways off missing columns; three import paths never filled the filter columns.
